title: Fix highlight misalignment after bookmark jump
description:
Jumping to a bookmark in PDF Viewer was resetting page layout to intrinsic sheet size while the continuous Viewer was still showing zoomed pages. Structure nodes kept using the live zoom size, but highlight lines painted from the reset board.pages size — so highlights drifted off the nodes (fat wrong-position lines with labels).

Bookmark focus no longer normalizes/replaces live page geometry when continuous Viewer is mounted. Overlay painting now uses the same live width/height for lines as for structure nodes.

Who is affected: PipeSync Plan View on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh Plan Sync (map32). If highlights still look wrong, Force redraw auto-highlights after refresh.
changeLog: Skip Viewer layout normalize on bookmark jump when continuous Viewer owns page size.
Paint highlight overlays using live slot width/height (same as structure nodes).
Refresh continuous overlays after bookmark focus.
